caption: Before you add AI to your product, answer these 3 questions. Most teams skip all of them.

slides.say: Before you add AI to your product, ask three questions. Most teams skip all of them.
First: what task does it actually make better? If you can't name one, it's a demo, not a feature.
Second: what happens when it's wrong? Every model makes mistakes. Design the fallback before you ship.

slides.screen: 3. How will you know it works?
slides.say: Third: how will you measure it? Pick one number before launch, not after.
If you can't answer all three, you're not ready yet. And that's fine. Follow for more.
